origin: Own exact leaf gas-exchange model, inspired by Farquhar-vonCaemmerer-Berry photosynthetic limitations. All source rows and the isotope signal are constructed noiseless mathematical observables, not empirical data for a named plant. Temperature, oxygen and fractionation factors are held fixed by this model. The optimization is a stipulated carbon-minus-conductance-cost criterion, not an empirical claim about universal plant behavior.
model: Let Cc be chloroplastic CO2 and Ci measured intercellular CO2. Net assimilation A=min[Vcmax*(Cc-Gamma)/(Cc+K), (J_light/4)*(Cc-Gamma)/(Cc+2Gamma)]-Rd. KnownGamma=40,K=400. Unknown constant parameters are Vcmax in[10,200], JH in[20,300], JL in[10,200], Rd in[0,5], mesophyll conductance gm in[0.05,1]; all are shared across the entire source. Light label H uses JH, label L uses JL. Mesophyll diffusion is A=gm*(Ci-Cc). Rates use common normalized assimilation units, CO2 common concentration units, and conductances assimilation/concentration units. Stomatal and mesophyll conductance are FOR CO2, not water. The two positive gross assimilation branches are called R(Rubisco) and J(electron-transport); Rd is subtracted AFTER taking their minimum.

isotope_observable.scope: This equation is the complete explicitly stipulated first-order observation model for this task; it is not claimed to contain every respiratory, ternary or diffusive correction in real isotope measurements. Ca, Ci, A come from the same gas row, so an inferred Cc and gm must satisfy all original equations and bounds.

global_calibration: The CSV has seven shuffled rows with exact rational strings. Preserve row IDs and infer gm from the matched isotope observation before fitting the photosynthetic branches. Recover all Cc values and consider EVERY binary R/J assignment of the seven gas rows, including exact colimitation. For each assignment the remaining four unknowns enter a linear system; distinguish an exact compatible solution from a least-squares residual and retain rank-deficient possibilities if any instead of arbitrarily setting free parameters to zero. Apply the declared parameter bounds and BOTH original min-branch inequalities, not only the assigned equality. Report the number of distinct physical parameter vectors and the number of exact branch assignments; tied limiter labels need not mean distinct physiology. Retain actual LinearLeastSquares on the COMPLETE7rowdesign for EACH exact compatible assignment, including all four coefficients, rank and residual. The finite assignment inventory and excluded cases may be computed in restricted numerical code, but every accepted assignment needs an actual full tool fit. Independently check whether the alternative Ci=Cc could exactly fit ALL source rows under any branch assignment; a convenient two-row fit cannot establish it.
stomatal_control: For prediction fix ambientCa=400, high light H, and all inferred physiology. Choose stomatal CO2 conductance g in[0,1]. For g>0, steady diffusion obeys A=g*(Ca-Ci)=gm*(Ci-Cc) together with the inferred min-branch assimilation law. Use the physical positive-assimilation branch continuously connected to the compensation point; quantify uniqueness rather than choosing an arbitrary quadratic root. At g=0 define A(0)=0 and Cc by the unique continuous compensation-point limit from g>0, avoiding divisionbyzero. The objective for any cost lambda>=0 is U_lambda(g)=A(g)-lambda*g; lambda already includes the environmental water-price factor, so do not multiply it by1.6again. All optimization concerns this exact specified objective.
global_policy_certificate: Derive the complete high-light A(g) curve implicitly or parametrically, including original physical inequalities. Determine colimitation Cc,A,g and the closed-limit compensation Cc. Prove continuous-domain monotonicity/concavity or give an equivalent rigorous global optimization certificate. Give every nonnegative cost threshold separating cap g=1, interior electron-limited optimum, exact-colimitation optimum, interior Rubisco-limited optimum and closed g=0. Determine endpoint inclusion and uniqueness, including threshold cases. In particular, a biochemical limiter switch can produce an interval of costs with the same optimum; a single smooth stationarity equation can miss it. A grid, unconstrained local optimizer or smoothing the min does not establish the complete policy.
actual_policy_audits: For costs[0,2,10,20,25,50,100,400]report the unique optimalg, netA, Cc(orclosedlimit), objectivevalue and regime label from {cap,electron_stationary,colimitation,Rubisco_stationary,closed}. For EACH strictly interior smooth optimum retain actual PolynomialRoots of the COMPLETE stationary polynomial after rational denominators are cleared, and reject nonphysical or wrong-branch roots using the ORIGINAL derivative and diffusion equations. Also retain actual PolynomialRoots for the complete high-light colimitation equation and g=1physical assimilation boundary equation. Report all roots in observations before selection; squaring/clearing denominators cannot license an inadmissible competitor. Scalar global proofs and actual source-to-fit-to-policy data handoffs stay in the trajectory.

interpretation_proposals.A: A finite internal CO2 drop can make fitting photosynthetic capacities at measured Ci instead of Cc scientifically inconsistent across an exact curve.
interpretation_proposals.B: An exact colimitation row proves two different physiological parameter vectors exist.
interpretation_proposals.C: A nonsmooth change of active biochemical limitation can hold the unique optimal conductance fixed over an interval of environmental costs.
interpretation_proposals.D: Every positive cost optimum must solve one smooth first-derivative equation in the interior.
interpretation_proposals.E: One exact fit under an assigned branch establishes compatibility without checking the competing branch inequality.
interpretation_proposals.F: Independent isotope information can constrain internal conductance under an explicitly stated fractionation model.
interpretation_proposals.G: This constructed carbon-cost optimum proves that every real C3 leaf uses the same control rule.
interpretation_proposals.H: Finite-source mechanism assignment, physical root selection and global policy endpoint checks are different parts of the scientific argument.

reporting: Use the public answer schema. Numeric tolerance1e-7absolute. Parameters ordered[Vcmax,JH,JL,Rd]; limiter sets ordered by G1throughG7, each containing R, J or both with internal order irrelevant. Branch-assignment count differs from distinct parameter-vector count. Thresholds increase as environmental cost grows, all costs nonnegative. Strict physical domains, exact label/count/bool claims, colimitation endpoint inclusion and optimizer uniqueness are exact. Tiny numerical residuals must be interpreted through the exact model, not as license for arbitrary negative conductances or assimilation.

primary_context.title: A biochemical model of photosynthetic CO2assimilation in leaves of C3species
primary_context.role: Primary biochemical-limitation context, verified against the original paper and ANU bibliographic record. The finite mesophyll/isotope observation model, exact source values, conductance-cost criterion and all calibration/design results are own task assumptions; no article figures,text or empirical measurements are reproduced.
